name: Nullharbor
notes: Fold-ready Nullharbor sideload APK. 2.16.6 compositor keep-alive + wake lock did not hold 120 on Chrome PWA (still 60 until the ship moves). Native games on the same Fold hold 120. GitHub Pages beta stays the fast web channel.

Package rename: applicationId / namespace com.nullharbor.game (was com.farbound.game). JS bridge NullharborAndroid with FarboundAndroid alias for existing save-export JS. Immersive fullscreen and keep-screen-on stay. Offline assets still come from dist/.

Native preferred refresh: preferredDisplayModeId + preferredRefreshRate at the current cover/inner resolution, Surface.setFrameRate(..., FIXED_SOURCE, CHANGE_FRAME_RATE_ALWAYS) on a 1 px hint surface, setPreferMinimalPostProcessing, re-apply on resume/fold/focus. API 35 votes setRequestedFrameRate + setFrameContentVelocity on the WebView and root. JS refreshLock() reports the requested Hz. FPS meter may add “shell 120”; it does not rewrite the RAF number.

Build: android/assemble-debug.sh or ./gradlew assembleDebug (Gradle 8.9 wrapper). preBuild copies dist/ → app/src/main/assets/. APK testers download from https://github.com/GabeTC99/Nullharbor/releases/latest. Tag android-v* / v*-android runs Android Release CI and uploads the asset. This ship is versionCode 9 / versionName 2.16.7, signed with android/sideload.keystore. Play Store and in-app updater are later. PC .exe launcher is later.

Verify on Fold: sideload the APK from Releases, Show FPS, hands-off cruise 10 s. Success is nearer 120 with shell 120 on the detail line. Updates: download a newer APK with a higher versionCode and the same sideload key (replaces the app). Pages PWA testers keep 2.16.2–2.16.6 flash/AA/hitch/meter behavior and should still expect 60 until motion. Service worker cache bumped to farbound-v2.16.7. Save keys stay farbound-save-v2.
